name: Miners' Gear
summary: In northern Loch Modan, Miners' Gear waits in the Silver Stream Mine. Kobolds have overrun the tunnels, and the Miners' League wants its tools recovered before the local guards attack.

sections.title: Supplies of the Miners' League
sections.body: The Silver Stream Mine ran out of ore, so the Miners' League made its quiet tunnels a depot for mining equipment. Kobolds overran the mine, seized the stored goods and made nests among the crates. The league fears an assault by the Mountaineers could wreck the dwarven gear, or scavengers could ruin it. Enter the mine and bring the crates to safety before either fate befalls them.

faq.answer: Miners' Gear is the Miners' League's crates of dwarven excavation tools, including picks and shovels, stored in the Silver Stream Mine's dry tunnels.

faq.q: Why was the gear left in the mine?
aliases: why is gear in silver stream mine
faq.answer: After the Silver Stream Mine ran out of ore, the Miners' League turned its empty tunnels into a storage depot. The gear stayed there until kobolds infested the shafts.
Mountaineer Stormpike directs the Miners' League's recovery effort. He wants the tools salvaged before his fellow warriors march in to kill the kobolds.

faq.q: Where is the Miners' Gear found?
faq.answer: The Miners' League's crates are scattered through the Silver Stream Mine's shafts, in northern Loch Modan east of Algaz Station.

angles.text: As a miner, you know the worth of well-forged dwarven iron. Leaving high-grade picks and shovels with candle-wearing scavengers is a small tragedy.
As a dwarf, you may find kobolds laying their filthy paws on dwarven craft an intolerable insult. The mine calls to be cleared at once.
